title: GSE circular executable-geometry peak-field Teacher feasibility
purpose: Determine whether every visible directed exit can be losslessly represented at a unique fixed bearing peak with metric geometry, while documenting why wide-sector connected components merge exits.

approval.scope: One immutable read-only C01-C08 representation audit; zero Teacher export, training, new inference, C09/C10/M-TARE, graph or planner.
approval.confirmation_reference: User explicitly delegated best-method decisions and continuous execution.

raw_sources: Sealed C01-C08 deduplicated range/valid arrays and observable exit targets.
Sealed C01-C08 incident-only exit-token audit with line-of-sight distance and opening geometry.
source.license_or_allowed_use: Local project-generated procedural worlds and derived geometry/LiDAR evidence.

worlds.forbidden: C09, C10 and all M-TARE worlds

sampling.rule: Use each sealed C01-C08 observation once. Rasterize every visible exit center to the nearest fixed 2-degree bin; retain a signed sub-bin residual and independent width-valid mask. Do not omit invalid-width exits.

teacher.source: TNG/spline/native-mesh derived incident exit visibility, robot-frame heading, opening width/mask and four-value vertical profile from the sealed dataset; line-of-sight distance only diagnoses the rejected wide-sector encoding.
teacher.use: No export occurs. Peak presence and metric values are constructed in memory and discarded after exact round-trip, collision, rotation and causality checks.
teacher.valid_mask: Visible exit presence is always valid; opening width has its own mask. Invalid width never removes a presence peak or vertical profile.
teacher.student_input: No student exists in this audit. The raw-range envelope baseline uses only the current fifth range/valid image and no Teacher identity, pose or future frame.
teacher.planner_consistency_plan: Future edges remain execution verified. This audit only qualifies a local exit representation and creates no graph.

split.checkpoint_and_threshold_selection: None; raw-range ranking reports all realizable tied thresholds at the existing 0.995 precision floor.
split.historical_pollution_audit: Only named sealed C01-C08 dataset/exit audit and V1R2 failure evidence are read.

methods.main: A 180-bin circular peak field stores presence, signed heading residual, opening width/mask and vertical profile at each exit center. Exact circular local maxima, not wide connected sectors or free queries, define exit tokens.
methods.baseline: Wide opening sectors decoded by circular connected components, plus a no-learning current-scan free-range envelope ranked against peak presence.
methods.fallback: Any center-bin collision, non-lossless geometry, rotation/causality failure or dependence on identity/future stops the field before Teacher export.

acceptance.population: Exact 80 worlds, 252430 raw frames, 188126 observations, 396913 visible exits and 389026/7887 width valid/invalid split.
acceptance.uniqueness: Zero same-bin and zero adjacent-bin exit-center collisions across all observations; exact 1/2/3/4 cardinality population.
acceptance.geometry: Heading round-trip and 20-degree rotation residual error at most 1e-4 degrees; width/profile exact; slot order invariant.
acceptance.causality: Every five-frame local/global reference is contiguous and strictly past-only.
acceptance.baseline_attribution: Reproduce 22626 wide-sector component-count mismatch rows and 22381 overlap rows; raw-range ranking is diagnostic only.
acceptance.system: All source hashes match; zero Teacher export/optimizer/new inference/threshold fitting/graph/C09/C10/M-TARE.

failure_policy: Any source, count, bin, wraparound, geometry-mask, rotation, reference or isolation ambiguity fails closed; do not change bin count or decode rule after results.
retention: Retain summary/CSV, PNG/PDF/SVG/source, raw log, environment, RUN_STATE and SHA-256 seal as representation-selection and paper evidence.

estimated_cost.compute: CPU read-only full shard verification, in-memory peak-field audit, one streaming 547MB sector baseline and raw-range ranking
